//: Copy to config.json and edit. Every key is optional except accounts[].id and accounts[].configDir.
//title: Text in the browser tab and in the panel header.
title: Rainbow Claude Monitor
//port: Local port. The panel is served at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/ and never listens on the network.
//openBrowser: Open the default browser when the server starts.
//location: Coordinates used to look up sunrise/sunset for the auto theme. null = no lookup, fall back to 06:00 / 21:00 local.

ui.//columns: Cards per row: a number, or "auto" (1-3 accounts -> one row, 4+ -> rows of 3).
ui.//theme: Startup theme: "light", "dark" or "auto" (follows the sun at location). The header toggle overrides it and is remembered per browser.
ui.//duskMinutes: Length of the fade between day and night palettes around sunrise/sunset.
ui.//refreshMs: How often the page asks the server for fresh numbers.
ui.//showSevenDay: Show the weekly limit bar under the 5-hour one.
ui.//hotPercent: Percentage at which a bar turns red.
ui.//accents: Optional overrides for the nine /color names, [r,g,b] each. Example: { "blue": { "day": [58,110,168], "night": [74,142,214] } }

usage.//source: "auto" - ask the Claude usage endpoint, fall back to the on-disk cache; "api" - live only; "cache" - never leave the machine.
usage.//liveOkSec: Seconds between live polls of a healthy account.
usage.//liveBadSec: Back-off after a failed live poll.

launch.//autoColor: After Launch, type /color <accent> into the window that just opened.
launch.//trustPromptKeys: Keys sent to a brand-new window to answer "Do you trust this folder?". "" disables it. Names: up down left right enter tab esc space.
launch.//waitSec: How long to wait for the launched window to appear before giving up.

//accounts: One entry per Claude account. id: any short slug, unique. label: shown on the card. configDir: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR of that account - absolute, or relative to %USERPROFILE%. launcher (optional): exe or shortcut the Launch button starts - absolute, or a name looked up on the Desktop, in %USERPROFILE% and in PATH; omit it and the card simply has no Launch button. launchArgs (optional): array of arguments. workingDir (optional): folder the window opens in, default %USERPROFILE%. accent (optional): colour a launched window is painted with - red orange yellow green cyan blue purple pink default.
